The additional buttonholes allow the cuff to be cinched more precisely and give the closure a more engineered, bespoke appearance. Visually it remains a classic squared double cuff, but the extra perforations signal a more customized, tailored construction.

LOCKED COUNT AND ARRANGEMENT — non-negotiable, and read from the drawing's lower (flat) panel: the cuff carries EXACTLY SIX worked buttonholes, no more and no fewer, arranged as TWO MIRRORED TRIADS — one triad inset from each short closure end of the cuff, none anywhere near the middle of the cuff face. Every buttonhole is a HORIZONTAL worked slit running parallel to the cuff's long edges (perpendicular to the short closure end), all of identical length, each a fully cut slit with dense worked edges and a bar tack at both ends. The two extra holes on the under leaf are the whole point of this option — they let the link be set at two different wrist depths — so their stacked pairing must be unmistakable and countable at a glance.
